gap: From about v4.9 to v5.8 the about cluster sits dead still while the copy scrolls up past it, and around v4.1 the camera passes a bare stretch of wall with neither cluster in view, so text and wall read as two separate motions rather than one slow dolly that carries the cluster gently along with the copy.
notes: Copy is legible, sits in light, and never overlaps a photo. The about frame at 5.4 is clean and on-palette. The cluster is laid out in a tidy grid of separate columns (portrait, index card, badge, coursework card, note) with wide gaps of empty wall. The bar's pieces overlap and layer, so this reads sparser and more like a form than a scrapbook. 'You Wee.' has the pink italic but no riso-blue misregistered copy like 'Liew' in the bar. At 4.6 the CGPA badge is cut off at the right edge. At 6.25 a bright bloom washes out the upper left. No console errors and no failed chapters.
